description:
It’s a feat inconceivable to most sound-minded mortals: This past Sunday, Denise Mueller-Korenek rode a bicycle more than 180 mph—183.93 to be exact, which is faster than the takeoff speed of an Airbus A340—and crushed the motor-paced bicycle land speed record.

For more, check out: https://www.bicycling.com/news/a23281242/denise-mueller-korenek-breaks-bicycle-speed-record/

#fastestbikes #denisemuellerkorenek #worldrecord

chapters.title: Denise Mueller-Korenek obliterated the bike land speed record.
183.93 miles per hour, to be exact
The former motor-paced bicycle land speed record of 167mph was set in 1995.

fulltitle: Denise Mueller-Korenek is the Fastest Person on a Bike EVER
